# Form Response

## Summary
One person's completed answers to a form — here realized as
`SurveyResponse` (`survey-response.gts`), the card the Survey fill-in
flow creates on submit.

## API
- `survey` — linksTo Survey (live link; reflects later title changes)
- `surveyId` — denormalized copy of the survey's id, for reliable querying when the link can't be loaded
- `surveyTitle` — display snapshot fallback
- `answers` — containsMany `SurveyAnswer` (`{ prompt, response }`): the prompt is snapshotted with the answer so a response stays readable after the survey's questions change
- `completedAt` semantics ride on the card's own timestamps

## Usage
Responses are created by the Survey isolated flow, not by hand. Consumers
query them by `surveyId` and read `answers`; the built-in results view on
the Survey card aggregates them.

## Non-goals
No respondent identity field by default — anonymous collection is the
common case, and a consumer that wants attribution adds its own link in an
extending card. No scoring: interpreting answers (NPS math, pass/fail) is
the consumer's.
